set.body:
PURPOSE

Evaluate Intaglio's newly landed compatibility policy from the StoryAtlas consumer side and define the gate for any renderer API expansion. Do not duplicate Intaglio's native tracker work in this store.

EXTERNAL BASELINE

- Intaglio main/origin main: 1742ce212b06e0a13c1605f4e6ed353a014ae43a.
- Compatibility commits: 0fc7baa and 1742ce2.
- Native open Intaglio Motes: intaglio-ci-matrix, intaglio-architecture-docs, intaglio-user-docs, intaglio-release-infra.
- Hosted Intaglio CI was not inspected at epic creation; local green evidence must remain labelled local.

ACCEPTANCE

- Review docs/compatibility.md and the compatibility/TASTy-MiMa/version-policy courts against StoryAtlas's consumed API surface.
- Run StoryAtlas's full consumer gate against the exact Intaglio commit in an isolated, non-mutating sibling setup; record the source and pin SHAs.
- Classify which native Intaglio Motes are prerequisites for a source pin, a published dependency, and an external user release. Do not turn documentation work into a false local compile blocker.
- Update the immutable pin only through a reviewed StoryAtlas change with compileAll, testAll, scalafmtCheckAll, app/fastLinkJS, static preview, and relevant browser evidence.
- Any proposed generic paint/pattern or compact representation begins with a reproducible StoryAtlas benchmark and preserves Intaglio's narrative-agnostic API boundary.
- Do not claim hosted CI, a release, or remote publication without direct evidence.
set.title: Consume the Intaglio compatibility baseline and gate renderer expansion
